core-concepts/envs.title: Environments
core-concepts/envs.description: The environment is the world in which MAGMA tasks are executed.

core-concepts/overview.title: Overview
core-concepts/overview.description: MAGMA is a framework for building, generating, and evaluating reasoning-heavy robotic tasks.

core-concepts/scenarios.title: Scenarios
core-concepts/scenarios.description: A scenario is the top-level package used to describe one application domain in MAGMA.

core-concepts/tasks.title: Tasks and Stages
core-concepts/tasks.description: A task is the unit of work an agent must solve in MAGMA.

core-concepts/tools.title: Tools
core-concepts/tools.description: Tools are the action interface between the agent and the robotic system.

installation.title: Core installation
installation.description: MAGMA can be installed depending on your needs. We provide 3 installations mode:

use-magma-gen/overview.title: Overview
use-magma-gen/overview.description: MAGMA-GEN is a sophisticated system designed to enable AI agents to perform long-horizon manipulation tasks in simulated environments without relying on human annotations. It uses maniskill3 to simulate real motion and tasks.

use-magma-gen/quickstart/installation.description: How to setup MAGMA-GEN for your configuration.

use-magma-gen/quickstart/launch-first-ge.title: Launch the first generation
use-magma-gen/quickstart/launch-first-ge.description: You need to have three terminal open and have defined your config as explained in Installation.

use-magma-gen/running-generation/cli-arg.title: MAGMA-GEN Generation CLI
use-magma-gen/running-generation/cli-arg.description: Learn how to launch the generation to adapt MAGMA-GEN to your configuration.
